briefs.source_chain: MSFT/Meta guide above consensus therefore GS raises 2026 hyperscaler capex to $751B (from $671B) therefore the raise is driven by a supply lock (HBM/CoWoS sold out through 1H27, top 4 buyers pulling 2027 orders forward), not demand for inference alone therefore rising HBM contract prices (+18% into 1Q27) keep pushing capex guides higher because the constraint is supply therefore cycle extends rather than peaks therefore Buy NVDA, $250 PT, invalidated if HBM contract prices fall two consecutive months (breaks pull-forward, cuts 2027 guides); a Fed decision is not expected to change this.
briefs.brief_chain: MSFT/Meta guide above consensus therefore GS raises 2026 hyperscaler capex to $751B (from $671B) therefore mechanism is supply not appetite: top 4 buyers pulling 2027 orders forward to lock HBM/CoWoS capacity sold out through 1H27 therefore rising HBM contract prices (+18% into 1Q27) push capex guides higher because constraint is supply therefore cycle extends rather than peaks therefore Buy NVDA, $250 target, invalidated if HBM contract prices fall two months running; Fed decision not expected to change the picture.

distortions.what: Source qualifies the driver as 'not demand for inference alone' (leaving room for inference demand as a partial factor); brief flattens this to 'not appetite' (a blanket demand denial).
distortions.would_the_trade_change: No — the stance, mechanism (supply lock), target, and invalidation are unchanged; this is a wording compression, not a causal or directional shift.
